(PH) {c_label}{u}Ultimate Eagle{/u}{/c} 
{icon:bullet,1.2} After a {c_number}[{SF_0}]{/c} second delay, the Eagle swoops through and deals {c_number}{payload:SKY_DAMAGE}{/c} Lightning damage to enemies.

{c_important}The Seeker's{/c} first hit Knocks Down enemies for {c_number}[{buffduration:KNOCKDOWN}]{/c} seconds. All of your attacks are guaranteed to Critically Strike for the duration of the Eagle Spirit.
{c_important}The Seeker{/c} constantly makes all Nearby enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} while active.
